_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Kamoe Pemain {player_id}, main {num_rounds} ronde Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Kamoe na ${pool} untuk bebagaan ronde nyoe antara droe ngon Pemain {other_id}.

Pembuat Tawaran:
  - Buat tawaran: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Jika diterima → Kamoe meupulang $(pool - X), pemain laen meupulang $X
  - Jika ditolak → Dua-dua meupulang $0
  - Contoh: [Offer: $3]  atawa  'Kamoe anggap nyoe adil. [Offer: $5]'

Penerima Tawaran:
  - Putuskeun tawaran ngon [Accept] atawa [Reject]
  - Contoh: 'Nyoe nampak masuk akal. [Accept]'
            'Terlalu tidak adil. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Ronde {round_number} dimulai! ---
Pemain {proposer_id} adalah pembuat tawaran, Pemain {responder_id} adalah penerima tawaran.
round.accepted: Pemain {responder_id} menerima! Ronde {round_number} untung: Pemain {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Pemain {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Total baru: Pemain 0: ${total_0}, Pemain 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Pemain {responder_id} menolak tawaran! Ronde {round_number} untung: Kedua pemain +$0. Total tetap: Pemain 0: ${total_0}, Pemain 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Peunula harus peuget tawaran deungen format [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Jumlah tawaran harus merupakan bilangan bulat yeng valid.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Hana tawaran saat nyoe untuk di respon.

outcome.win: Pemain {winner} meungang dengan ${winner_total} total lawan Pemain {loser} se ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Draw! Mandua peumeuén meupeuseuleusoe deungen ${total} total.
